name: @ndonfris/tree-sitter-fish
description: Tree-sitter grammar for Fish shell with WebAssembly support
author: ndonfris

scripts.dev: node scripts/build.js && echo 'Build complete. Run again after changes.'
scripts.prepublishOnly: yarn build && test -f dist/index.js || (echo 'Bundle missing!' && exit 1)
scripts.test: node -e "const pkg = require('./dist/index.js'); console.log('✓ Package loads correctly'); console.log('✓ Exports:', Object.keys(pkg)); console.log('✓ Language:', pkg.languageName); console.log('✓ Version:', pkg.version);"
